source_units: is a free iPad app for keeping sheet music PDFs in one place, opening them quickly, and adding light handwritten notes while you practice. It is designed around a practical score library: import PDFs, jump back to useful pages, mark practice spots, and quietly look back on your practice history with a calendar-style heatmap and links back to the scores and pages you worked on.
Import and organize sheet music PDFs for reading on iPad.

for passages that need repeated work.
as a quiet calendar-style heatmap and reopen the scores and pages you practiced.
Track recent practice time by score so the library reflects what you are actually working on.
Turn pages remotely from another iOS device while ScoreShelf is open as the reader.

Screenshot: Practice History with a calendar-style heatmap and links back to practiced pages.
Keep PDFs together and return to the right score without hunting through files.
